data.title: Saadiyat Lagoons
data.about:
Nestled in the heart of Abu Dhabi's prestigious Saadiyat Island, the project is an embodiment of luxury, culture, and exquisite natural beauty. The villas, available in 4, 5, or 6 bedroom options, are sustainably designed, reflecting a harmonious balance between environmentally conscious practices and modern architectural elegance.

Each villa showcases energy efficient materials, smart home technologies, and water saving appliances, underlining our commitment to green living. Expansive windows not only invite an abundance of natural light but also offer breathtaking views of the surrounding landscapes.

characteristics_module.title: Meticulously selected natural materials for an authentic sense of place.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime location on Abu Dhabi's prestigious Saadiyat Island.
  • Luxurious living amidst stunning natural landscapes.
  • Project by renowned developer Aldar Properties.
  • Eco Friendly construction materials signify sustainable luxury.
  • Variety in residences: villas, townhouses, apartments.
  • Easy access to key areas: airport, malls, Yas Island.
  • Amenities: pools, gym, playgrounds, gardens, more.
  • Contemporary designs with high end finishes.
  • Exclusive, high value investment location.
  • Assurance of quality from trusted developer Aldar.

location_tile.title: Luxurious Haven at Saadiyat Island
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Saadiyat Lagoons District in Abu Dhabi, a green residential enclave on Saadiyat Island that merges artistic landmarks with the majesty of nature. Inhabitants enjoy immediate proximity to esteemed establishments.

  • 10 Minutes to Jubail Mangrove Park
  • 20 Minutes to Burjeel Hospital
  • 25 Minutes to Marina Mall
  • 25 Minutes to Downtown Abu Dhabi
